features.quote: Max iterations N (suggest 15–20) and wall-clock timeout, whichever first.
features.justification_quote: Cap N tightly; the marginal info from turns 15→25 is usually low. Track tokens/run as a leading indicator — runaway-token cascades blow budgets.
